implementation: Party/focus/pet target strips share HP sinks, rotated fill, common insets, status/class colors and loss lifecycle. No resource bar or target layout setting changed. Trough/loss/fill levels are explicit above the target frame background.

Readable damage uses height and bottom anchors; repeated hits retain the trailing edge. Clear on healing, max-health change, empty target, resize, hide or identity replacement. Horizontal HUD path preserved; Classic repeated-hit edge correction shared.

Restricted health/max/GUID/status samples never enter arithmetic or boolean tests. Existing native SetValue catch-up supports vertical orientation; generations cancel stale callbacks on rebind/hide/disable.

Effects precreated outside combat even when disabled; existing secure visibility, Flux hover bindings and option gates retained. Target geometry defers during combat. Focus horizontal fallback remains horizontal on noncompact presentation.
